title: Compositional analysis and physicochemical characterization of a purified tremella fuciformis polysaccharide-rich fraction and its intestinal barrier- and microbiota-related effects in DSS-induced colitis.
authors: Deng, Xinjiu; Li, Haikun; Hou, Jiamei; Tong, Changci; Liu, Jinpeng; Zhu, Yanwen; Liu, Yunen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究银耳多糖的理化表征及其在结肠炎模型中的肠道屏障与菌群调节作用，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Tremella fuciformis is a widely consumed edible fungus and a source of structurally diverse polysaccharides, but the intestinal biofunctionality of a purified Tremella polysaccharide-rich fraction remains insufficiently defined. In this study, a purified T. fuciformis polysaccharide-rich fraction (TPS) was obtained by hot-water extraction, ethanol precipitation, anion-exchange chromatography, and gel filtration. TPS was characterized using carbohydrate/protein analysis, gel permeation chromatography (GPC), monosaccharide composition analysis, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), X-ray diffraction (XRD), atomic force microscopy (AFM), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), (1)H NMR, dynamic light scattering (DLS), zeta-potential analysis, and thermogravimetric analysis. TPS contained 96.13% total carbohydrate and 5.61% protein and showed features of a mannose-rich acidic heteropolysaccharide, including mainly amorphous organization, aggregated morphology, mixed anomeric proton signals, hydrated colloidal aggregates, negative surface charge, and staged thermal degradation behavior. Its intestinal effects were evaluated in a dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced colitis mouse model. Oral TPS administration alleviated DSS-induced colonic injury, as indicated by improved disease activity and histological features, preservation of ZO-1 and Occludin expression, and reduced colonic TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6 levels. TPS was also associated with partial changes in DSS-disrupted gut microbiota profiles and with lower downstream inflammatory protein readouts in the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway. Molecular docking of TPS-associated monosaccharides was retained only as supplementary exploratory in silico context and was not interpreted as evidence of intact TPS binding, validated receptor engagement, or direct in vivo TLR4 targeting. Overall, this study connects fraction-level compositional and physicochemical characterization of a food-derived Tremella polysaccharide-rich fraction with measurable intestinal barrier-, inflammation-, and microbiota-related responses, providing a basis for future structure-function studies of edible fungal polysaccharides in intestinal health.
abstract_zh: 银耳（Tremella fuciformis）是一种广泛食用的食用菌，也是结构多样多糖的来源，但纯化银耳多糖富集组分的肠道生物功能性仍未被充分界定。本研究通过热水提取、乙醇沉淀、阴离子交换色谱和凝胶过滤获得纯化银耳多糖富集组分（TPS）。采用碳水化合物/蛋白质分析、凝胶渗透色谱（GPC）、单糖组成分析、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）、X射线衍射（XRD）、原子力显微镜（AFM）、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、(1)H NMR、动态光散射（DLS）、zeta电位分析和热重分析对TPS进行表征。TPS含96.13%总碳水化合物和5.61%蛋白质，表现出富含甘露糖的酸性杂多糖特征，包括主要为无定形结构、聚集形态、混合异头质子信号、水合胶体聚集体、负表面电荷和分阶段热降解行为。其肠道效应在葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的结肠炎小鼠模型中评估。口服TPS给药缓解了DSS诱导的结肠损伤，表现为疾病活动和组织学特征改善、ZO-1和Occludin表达保留，以及结肠TNF-α、IL-1β和IL-6水平降低。TPS还与DSS破坏的肠道菌群谱的部分变化以及TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB通路中下游炎症蛋白读数降低相关。TPS相关单糖的分子对接仅作为补充性探索性计算机模拟背景保留，并未被解释为完整TPS结合、验证受体参与或直接体内TLR4靶向的证据。总体而言，本研究将食品来源银耳多糖富集组分的组分级组成和理化表征与可测量的肠道屏障、炎症和菌群相关反应联系起来，为未来食用菌多糖在肠道健康中的结构-功能研究提供基础。
